summary: The D.C. Elections Board is seeking to keep the National Guard away from ballot drop boxes, while advocates argue against National Guard presence in the District more broadly and highlight ongoing challenges to local authority. A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, and D.C. Vote has documented multiple instances of attacks on the District's autonomy. Without statehood, D.C. cannot control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
